subject.title: fix(gateway): skip secrets.resolve when target SecretRefs use exec providers

question: After the optional-path repair, should command-secret resolution skip the gateway RPC for required active exec-backed target SecretRefs and resolve them locally when local exec is allowed?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but the behavior decides when configured exec SecretRefs execute locally instead of attempting the gateway snapshot path, which is an auth/security-sensitive boundary.

options.title: Fix optional-path skip, then accept
options.body: Exclude optional-active paths from the pre-gateway exec skip, add focused coverage, refresh the branch, and land if maintainers accept the required-active local execution boundary.

options.title: Keep gateway-first semantics
options.body: Reject this CLI preflight skip and leave the linked issue open for a gateway-owned partial-resolution contract or log-noise solution.

options.title: Require gateway/runtime redesign
options.body: Supersede this PR with a runtime-side resolver change if maintainers want the gateway to return partial snapshot assignments instead of using a CLI skip.

recommendation.title: Fix optional-path skip, then accept
recommendation.body: Exclude optional-active paths from the pre-gateway exec skip, add focused coverage, refresh the branch, and land if maintainers accept the required-active local execution boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the remaining choice is acceptance of the auth/security boundary after the mechanical bug is fixed.
